picks.question: Will the Fed increase interest rates by 25 bps after the September 2026 meeting?
picks.why: Pricing is near a coin flip on whether the Fed hikes rather than holds in September.

picks.question: Will inflation reach more than 4.5% in 2026?
picks.why: Tests whether inflation re-accelerates far above target, which would reset rate expectations and real returns.

picks.question: Will the Iranian regime fall before 2027?
picks.why: Regime collapse in Iran would move oil markets and reorder Middle East trade and security.

picks.question: Will Anthropic have the best AI model at the end of December 2026?
picks.why: Frontier model leadership shapes AI capital spending, competition, and the valuations driving recent equity gains.

picks.question: OpenAI announces it has achieved AGI before 2027?
picks.why: An AGI declaration would trigger contractual, regulatory, and labor-market debates well beyond the technology sector.

picks.question: Billionaire one-time wealth tax passes in California election 2026?
picks.why: A state wealth tax would test capital mobility and set precedent for other tax authorities.
